BookPage.heading: Book a consultation with Alejandra
BookPage.intro: Thirty minutes, one to one. We talk about where your wardrobe is now, where you want it to go, and which service actually gets you there — before you spend anything.
BookPage.expect1Body: What you own, what you avoid, what you keep buying and never wear. There is no wrong answer here and nothing to prepare.
BookPage.expect2Body: Most wardrobes are not short of clothes. They are short of a through-line. We find yours.
BookPage.expect3Body: A clear recommendation — a service, the Vault, or neither — and the reasoning behind it. No pressure to book anything on the call.
BookPage.faq1A: Thirty minutes, by video. If we need longer, we will say so and schedule it properly rather than rush.
BookPage.faq2A: No. The consultation is free and carries no obligation to book a service afterwards.
BookPage.faq3A: Nothing. If it helps, have your wardrobe nearby — but come as you are and we will work from there.
BookPage.faq4A: Yes. Alejandra works in both English and Spanish; choose whichever you think in.
BookPage.schedulerFallback: The scheduler is loading. If it does not appear, open it in a new tab.
BookPage.consentBody: Our booking calendar is provided by Calendly, which sets its own cookies. We do not load it until you say so — so nothing is sent to Calendly unless you choose to open it.
BookPage.consentRemember: We will remember this choice on this device.
BookPage.consentAlternative: Rather not? Open the calendar directly on Calendly

meta.title: The Vault | AC Styling
meta.description: Self-paced courses in colour, body shape, style and essence, and closet curation. The method Alejandra Carrillo uses with her clients.

hero.title: Your style already speaks for you. Learn to direct it.
hero.lede: AC Styling's school: the same method I use with my clients, in courses you take at your own pace.

mirror.title: If any of this sounds familiar:
mirror.item1: You buy something you loved in the shop and never wear it at home.
mirror.item2: Someone told you you're "warm-toned" and you never worked out what to do with that.
mirror.item3: You have clothes you like and clothes you wear, and almost nothing in the overlap.
mirror.close: It isn't a shortage of clothes. It's a shortage of criteria, and criteria can be taught.

method.title: Why does it happen?
method.cognition: Clothes don't only change how you're read. They change how you think. In a study by Adam and Galinsky at Northwestern, two groups wore the same white coat: the group told it was a doctor's coat showed better sustained attention. Same garment, different story, different performance.
method.thesis: So I don't teach trends. I teach you to decide: which colours hold you up, which silhouettes represent you, and what you want to communicate before you open the closet.

path.title: The path
path.lede: Four courses, in the order they build on each other. Each one also stands alone.
path.colourBody: Your season isn't a box. It's a position between three things: temperature, value and intensity. The course takes you there with a method you can repeat on your own, in front of the mirror.
path.fieldAlt: A continuous colour field. Temperature runs warm to cool across the horizontal axis and value runs light to dark down the vertical. The four seasons — spring, summer, autumn and winter — appear as soft regions rather than boxes.
path.splitNote: Four seasons here. The twelve sub-seasons need real light and a trained eye, so I keep them for one-to-one analysis. It isn't a cut-down version: it's honestly how far a course can take you.
path.shapeBody: Not a list of things to hide. You learn to read your proportions and lines, and to choose cuts and silhouettes that work with them instead of against them.
path.essenceBody: This is the heart of the method. Colour and silhouette are tools; your essence is what they're for. You learn the universal styles, find your own mix, and finish with your essence defined in words you can dress by.
path.closetTitle: Your closet: make it work for your life
path.closetBody: Audit what you own, organise it, tailor what's worth keeping and buy with criteria, so your essence reaches your ordinary mornings and not only your best days.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Do I need to know anything before I start?
faq.a1: No. The courses start from zero and each module builds on the one before. The masterclasses follow an order (colour, body shape, style and essence, closet), but each one stands alone.
faq.a2: About an hour per masterclass, split into short modules so you can take them one at a time.
faq.a3: You create your account at checkout and go straight into the Vault, in your browser. There's nothing to download.
faq.q4: How long do I keep it?
faq.a4: For life. No renewals, no monthly fee, no expiry date.
faq.a5: Every course is recorded in both Spanish and English. You choose inside the platform.
faq.q6: What can I watch it on?
faq.a6: Any browser: phone, tablet or computer.
faq.a7: Credit and debit card, through Stripe.
faq.a8: No. All sales are final, as set out in our refund policy.
faq.q9: Does this replace working with you directly?
faq.a9: No, and it isn't meant to. The course gives you the criteria and takes you to your season. Working one to one settles your exact sub-season and your real closet. Plenty of clients do both, in that order.
